question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. **

Play with fire
solution:
The correct answer is **'To do something dangerous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'Play with fire' **is **'To do something dangerous'.**
 
• **Play with fire:** take foolish risks. (मूर्खतापूर्ण जोखिम उठाएं)
 
 
• *Example: An urge to** play with fire** made her provoke him.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To do something dangerous.*
